title: Nowhere near, twice as, all the more
summary: So sánh nâng cao: nowhere near/nothing like as, twice/three times as … as, all the more, the + so sánh hơn, considerably/marginally.

dialogue.en: It's [[twice as big as]] the old one.
It's [[nowhere near as expensive as]] I expected.
dialogue.vi: Rẻ hơn nhiều so với mình tưởng.

dialogue.en: [[Considerably shorter]]. That makes it [[all the more]] attractive.
dialogue.vi: Ngắn hơn đáng kể. Vì thế nó càng hấp dẫn hơn.

sections.heading: Twice / three times as … as
sections.rule: **twice / three times / half + as + tính từ + as** = gấp hai / ba / một nửa. Cũng nói **three times + so sánh hơn + than**.

examples.en: This room is [[twice as big as]] mine.
examples.vi: Phòng này rộng gấp đôi phòng tôi.

examples.en: Rent here is [[three times higher than]] in my town.
examples.vi: Tiền thuê ở đây cao gấp ba ở quê tôi.
examples.why: Three times + so sánh hơn + than.

examples.en: It costs [[half as much as]] the new model.
examples.vi: Nó rẻ bằng một nửa mẫu mới.

check.prompt: This phone is ___ as expensive as that one.

sections.heading: Nowhere near, nothing like, considerably, marginally
sections.rule: **nowhere near / nothing like as … as** = kém xa. **considerably / significantly** (hơn nhiều), **marginally / slightly** (hơn chút) đứng trước so sánh hơn.

examples.en: The film was [[nowhere near as good as]] the book.

examples.vi: Năm nay giá cao hơn đáng kể.
Cô ấy nhanh hơn tôi một chút.

check.prompt: The test was ___ near as hard as I feared.

sections.heading: All the more, the + so sánh hơn
sections.rule: **all the more + so sánh hơn / tính từ** = **càng thêm** (vì một lý do). **The + so sánh hơn…, the + so sánh hơn** = càng… càng.

examples.en: Her success is [[all the more]] impressive because she is so young.
examples.vi: Thành công của cô ấy càng ấn tượng vì cô ấy còn rất trẻ.

examples.en: [[The longer]] you wait, [[the harder]] it gets.
examples.why: The + so sánh hơn, the + so sánh hơn.

check.prompt: The sooner we start, ___ we'll finish.
check.explain: The + so sánh hơn, the + so sánh hơn.

mistakes.wrong: This house is two times bigger as that one.
mistakes.right: This house is twice as big as that one.

mistakes.wrong: It is nowhere near so good than the first film.
mistakes.right: It is nowhere near as good as the first film.

mistakes.wrong: The more you practice, the better you get it.
mistakes.right: The more you practice, the better you get.
